name: Cameron County, TX
findings: Cameron County has 557 nonprofit organizations. 176 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 147 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cameron County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
